🆕 NEW RELEASE: The Interrupters share Back From The Dead from Battle Scars

The Interrupters released the single Back From The Dead on 5 November 2026, with a music video. It is track 8 on their album Battle Scars, due on 29 January 2027 via Hellcat/Epitaph. Singer Aimee Interrupter says the song is about a near-death experience.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: RORY bring The Bloodletting Tour to Germany in 2027

RORY play four German club shows in January 2027 on The Bloodletting Tour: Cologne on 23 January, Berlin on 24 January, Hamburg on 26 January and Munich on 27 January. The dates follow her second album Bloodletting, released on 11 September 2026 on her own label.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Pierce The Veil and Millencolin join Graspop 2027

Pierce The Veil and Millencolin are among the acts added to the lineup of Graspop Metal Meeting 2027. The festival runs from 17 to 20 June 2027 in Dessel, Belgium.
